enquete.secreto: Secret ballot: nobody sees who voted for what, only the totals.
enquete.depois: Totals show up after you vote.

imagens.altDica: For people who cannot see it: what is in the image?
imagens.altFalta: Without a description, screen reader users miss the image. Please write one.
imagens.limpa: Location and camera data are removed from the image before sending.
imagens.semDetector: This device cannot find faces on its own: drag over each face to blur it.
imagens.invalida: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP image.
imagens.semAcesso: Sign in to see the image.

audio.semPermissao: No permission to use the microphone.

previa.falha: We could not build a preview for this link. It will show as plain text.
previa.nota: Our server builds the preview: neither your browser nor the reader's touches the site.

agendar.agendado: Scheduled for {quando}. If Alumia is closed then, it comes out the next time you open it.
agendar.cedo: Pick a time between 5 minutes and 30 days ahead.

rascunho.recuperado: We recovered the draft saved on this device.

checagem.cpf: This looks like a CPF number. Remove it: personal data does not go on Alumia.
checagem.telefone: This looks like a phone number. Remove it: personal data does not go on Alumia.
checagem.email: This looks like an e-mail address. Remove it: personal data does not go on Alumia.
checagem.endereco: This looks like a street address with a number. Remove it: saying where someone lives or is exposes them.
checagem.odio: The text has words that tend to hurt. You can send it, but moderators read it before it appears.

editar.livre: In the first 15 minutes you can edit without a trace.
editar.marca: After that the post is marked as edited and the earlier text stays visible.
editar.retido: The edit went to moderator review before it reappears.

erros.invalido_midia: Check the images: JPG, PNG or WebP, at most 4.
erros.invalido_audio: Check the audio: up to 1 minute.
erros.invalido_opcoes: Check the poll options: 2 to 4, all different, up to 80 characters each.
erros.invalido_prazo: A poll lasts from 1 hour to 7 days.
erros.invalido_previa: The preview link is not valid.
erros.invalido_quando: Pick a time between 5 minutes and 30 days ahead.
erros.invalido_fio: You can only continue your own post.
erros.ja_votou: You already voted in this poll.
erros.dado_pessoal: Remove CPF, phone, e-mail or street address with number from the text: personal data does not go on Alumia.
